description: This Java class 'TestConstants' defines various static constants, methods, and objects used as test fixtures or sample data for testing purposes within the 'org.eclipse.ditto.model.connectivity' package. It includes measurement data, JSON objects, and predefined measurement instances related to metrics and timestamps.

methods.name: getMeasurementJson
